rules: Do not borrow a current label/mount state to establish the historical child state.
Do not start an app, change labels/mounts, remount, load a library or install anything.
For all three boards use the same unmodified plan and record its SHA and boot_id before/after.
If the failed child is absent, report unavailable; fresh child observation requires another approved window.

same_plan.purpose: Future same-scope comparison, not retroactive repair of mismatched historical plans

minimal_fields.collect: sha256sum + ls -lnZ, including ancestors and actual bind source path; same boot and time on each board
covering mount root/target/options including noexec,nosuid, source identity and namespace links; unavailable child remains unknown
execution domain + UID/GID and path permissions; root shell success is not app-domain access proof
read-only SHA + ls -lnZ through the child's path view if it still exists
same child PID/boot/time access denials and exact path; absence of AVC is not proof of permission; obtain real crash PC only if an actual fatal signal exists

unresolved: 5ea exact child access-denial operation and cause
whether either failure shares an underlying permission mechanism
